categories.main_business_segments: Tsurumi Manufacturing Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the manufacturing and sale of submersible pumps, various other pumps, environmental equipment, and related machinery. The company also provides repair, after-sales services, installation works, and leasing of equipment, with business segments organized by region: Japan, North America, Asia, Europe, and Other (including China and Australia).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary pump technologies, including advanced submersible pump design, high-efficiency motors, and environmental equipment. Production methods emphasize in-house casting of stainless steel and high-chromium iron components, 3D sand mold technology for rapid, high-precision manufacturing, and flexible manufacturing systems (FMS) for automation and productivity. Recent investments include motor in-house production and advanced casting facilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tsurumi serves a wide range of customers, primarily in the construction, civil engineering, municipal infrastructure, disaster recovery, mining, and industrial equipment sectors. Major end markets include construction equipment rental companies, public sector agencies, factories, and water treatment facilities, with a growing focus on disaster response and environmental sustainability.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint, with major operations in Japan (headquarters and main factories), North America (notably the US), Asia (Taiwan, Vietnam, China, Thailand, Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Korea), Europe (Italy and subsidiaries), and other regions including Australia, South Africa, and the Middle East. Japan remains the largest market, but overseas sales are significant and expanding.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tsurumi operates primarily as a midstream and downstream manufacturer, producing finished pumps and environmental equipment for direct sale to end users, distributors, and rental companies. The company has increased vertical integration by internalizing key component production (motors, cast parts) and maintains a robust after-sales and service network.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening manufacturing capabilities ('monozukuri'), expanding global reach, and enhancing resilience to climate change and supply chain risks. R&D focuses on high-efficiency, environmentally friendly pumps, disaster recovery solutions, and the integration of digital and automation technologies. The company is also pursuing sustainability goals, such as reducing GHG emissions (Green Plan 2030), and leveraging synergies from recent acquisitions (e.g., ZENIT in Italy) for product and technology development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of pumps, environmental equipment, and related products, as well as installation, repair, and after-sales services. Additional income streams include equipment leasing, real estate rental, and, to a lesser extent, contract works and component sales. Revenue recognition is based on product delivery or project completion, with some long-term contracts recognized by progress.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tsurumi is a leading player in the global submersible pump market, competing with both domestic (e.g., Ebara, Torishima) and international manufacturers (e.g., Grundfos, KSB, Xylem). The company is recognized for its reliability, technological innovation, and strong presence in disaster recovery and construction markets. Its acquisition of ZENIT has strengthened its position in Europe and broadened its product lineup.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales reached 68.1 billion yen, with operating profit of 10.3 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 8.8 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady growth over the past five years, with sales and profits increasing, driven by domestic demand, overseas expansion, and strategic acquisitions. Total assets stand at 131.5 billion yen, and the company maintains a strong equity ratio and cash position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tsurumi emphasizes high reliability, rapid delivery, and robust after-sales support, particularly for mission-critical applications such as disaster recovery and infrastructure. Its products are differentiated by proprietary technologies (e.g., non-clogging, high-efficiency, automated control), environmental performance, and adaptability to diverse global needs. The company positions itself as a trusted partner for social infrastructure and sustainability, under the slogan 'For The Earth, For All The People.'
